title: Self-consistency: nouls
pattern: Keep a review band around uncertain yes/no probabilities.
application: Triage ambiguous cases without forcing a binary action.
limit: Repeatability is not accuracy; the sample varies an irrelevant uid and covers one claim.

title: Self-consistency: choices
pattern: Abstain when the winning label probability is too low.
application: Moderation and routing with a visible human-review option.
limit: Top-label probability and the separate confidence field are different. Thresholds are illustrative.

title: Parallel questions
pattern: Ask independent Choice, Noul, and Score questions over one shared state.
application: Evaluate many review dimensions in a single document request.
limit: The reported speed comparison uses sequential single-question calls; gains depend on workload.

title: Re-ranking
pattern: Use fast retrieval for a shortlist, then Noul-score each query–candidate pair.
application: Search results, help-center retrieval, and RAG reranking.
limit: Reranking cannot recover documents missing from the shortlist; the example uses 40 queries.

title: Line-by-line search
pattern: Rank line IDs with Choice and ask a separate Noul about answer existence.
application: Find supporting clauses and highlight exact source lines.
limit: A winning line can still be irrelevant. More than 255 candidate lines requires staged search.

title: Structure recovery
pattern: Batch line-continuation decisions, then classify blocks and render markup in code.
application: Recover headings, lists, quotations, and code from flattened text.
limit: The document takes two dependent passes; join thresholds and ambiguous block types need evaluation.

title: Function calling
pattern: Map functions and enum arguments to Choices; flags, sets, and optional presence to Nouls.
application: Typed tool dispatch for agents and natural-language interfaces.
limit: Consume only the selected branch. Free text and arbitrary numeric arguments are not generated by this recipe.

title: Skill suggestion
pattern: Rank a skill roster, then inspect the top few with richer descriptions and fit checks.
application: Choose an agent skill or abstain when no skill applies.
limit: A suggestion can make an already-correct agent worse; the study includes generated requests and a documented false suggestion.

title: Knowledge graph entity alignment
pattern: Use an ordered match rubric plus independent field-agreement checks.
application: Deduplicate products or align records across catalogs.
limit: Candidates must already exist. A three-level Score is rounded into different/review/same; semantic levels still need domain validation.

title: Classifying RAG passages
pattern: Check relevance, answer evidence, contradiction, and injection for each passage.
application: Separate useful evidence, conflicting evidence, and excluded passages before generation.
limit: The filter is not a security boundary. A generative model still writes the answer.

title: Double-checking citations
pattern: Check quote presence in code, then judge whether its context supports the claim.
application: Audit generated citations and surface unsupported claims.
limit: Exact normalized matching can reject paraphrases. Source support does not establish the source’s truth.

title: Guardrails for LLMs
pattern: Evaluate independent hazards and severity, then apply a named policy in code.
application: Screen both model inputs and outputs; route to pass, review, block, or support.
limit: Policy thresholds need labeled traffic; a probability threshold is not guaranteed protection.

title: SDE cascade
pattern: Verify a cheap extractor’s fields and escalate when any specific error signal fires.
application: Spend stronger-model calls on difficult structured extraction cases.
limit: Requires additional extraction models. The walkthrough fixes one fabricated example; its aggregate quality chart is an internal snapshot.

title: Date extraction
pattern: Choose date components and mode, then resolve calendar arithmetic in code.
application: Read deadlines, relative dates, and explicit dates with review flags.
limit: Date conventions, missing years, out-of-range years, and unsupported expressions need explicit code policies.

title: Pre-parsed value extraction
pattern: Find candidate spans first, let Jev select by role, then copy and normalize.
application: Extract the right email, phone number, or invoice amount without rewriting it.
limit: Candidate discovery limits recall; names need a roster or another extractor, and money normalization is locale-dependent.

title: Hierarchical classification
pattern: Keep multiple taxonomy paths and batch frontier questions using beam search.
application: Navigate product catalogs, code trees, patents, and subject taxonomies.
limit: The recipe shows four examples, not broad accuracy evidence. Path scores use a geometric mean, not a calibrated leaf probability.

title: Autoresearch feature discovery
pattern: An LLM proposes questions; Jev produces numeric features; supervised errors guide revisions.
application: Learn useful text features for rating prediction and other labeled-text tasks.
limit: Needs labeled data, a proposer model, a learner, and an untouched test set. Inference cost scales with rows and rounds.

title: Classification using confidence
pattern: Use the returned confidence to choose a narrow label or its broader parent.
application: Return useful coarse categories instead of over-specific guesses.
limit: The study uses 60 filtered, self-labeled filings. Reporting a parent category is still fallible.
